agents.label: Media librarian
cannot: infer semantic contents beyond file metadata

agents.label: Timeline executor
responsibilities: apply supported pan and zoom presets

agents.label: Visual analyst
agents.input_policy: user-consented selected assets or generated low-resolution frames only
responsibilities: describe composition and likely shot content from explicitly selected resized previews
compare a selected batch of shot previews with the director brief
report visible evidence and uncertainty without claiming to inspect full video clips
release_gate: configured provider route and actual worker/model identity
explicit consent before each remote preview-analysis request
asset-ID grounding and JPEG payload-bound tests
provider timeout, quota, incomplete-result and malformed-plan tests

agents.label: Creative director
responsibilities: convert the brief and selected preview evidence into a structured proposed edit plan
suggest bounded per-shot timing, supported motion, framing and text-overlay changes
emit a schema-validated plan bound to actual local clip and asset IDs
release_gate: review and approval before timeline mutation
post-render visual critique before claiming end-to-end autonomous quality
benchmark suite across distinct visual tasks

agents.label: Motion designer
responsibilities: map transitions and keyframes to supported engine operations

agents.label: Visual critic
responsibilities: compare result with brief and references
release_gate: no self-reported success without render evidence
